actual_proposal_projection.reason: Normalize the HCN request: identity 氰化氢HCN (query alias hydrogen cyanide); explicit charge 0 (中性), multiplicity 1 (单重态), environment gas_phase (气相). Method (RHF/PBE0) and basis (def2-SVP/def2-TZVP) are explicitly delegated to the program, so recorded in automatic_selection with exact quotes rather than as unknown conditions; select_conditions must run before scientific execution and record actual values. Goals: prepared_geometry (input, no geometry_relation), GIAO shielding tensors and isotropic shielding on the fixed initial geometry (fixed_initial per 固定几何), trace-consistency check, and delivery bundle. All verification reported_with_limitations (no qualified minimum-evidence demand). Seed 1701 and no-fabrication/limitation-reporting requirements are delivery/reporting constraints, not separate scientific Goals. missing_geometry notice: geometry must be prepared via structure.resolve/prepare.

Identity for HCN is resolved (structure-identity-3 passed). The only pending Step is the approved structure.prepare, which will generate and save the initial reasonable geometry for system_hcn. Executing it is the required next step before method/basis selection and GIAO shielding calculations.

decision.reason: Identity for HCN is resolved (structure-identity-3 passed). method.reason: User restricts to RHF or PBE0. PBE0 (hybrid DFT) is chosen because GIAO NMR shielding benefits from hybrid-DFT treatment of the paramagnetic term; it is a standard, well-tested choice for light-element shielding and is affordable for a 3-atom molecule. RHF would neglect electron correlation in the paramagnetic contribution.

basis.reason: User restricts to def2-SVP or def2-TZVP. def2-TZVP is chosen because NMR shielding tensors are sensitive to basis-set completeness near the nuclei; triple-zeta with polarization is the more reliable of the two allowed options. Cost is negligible for HCN (3 atoms, 4 cores, 192 MB/core).

Selecting PBE0/def2-TZVP with documented cost rationale; then a GIAO shielding calculation on the fixed prepared geometry will follow.
